notable_absence.finding: No authentication or authorization requirement is stated anywhere on this page for reaching the Metrics REST API/port 4986 - contrast with api.metrics_interface_authentication appearing as a bare, undescribed row in command-line-options.md's Table 1 (also this batch). This page neither names that setting nor states whether the metrics endpoint is open or gated by default.

cross_component_finding: I read this page (deploy/stats-prometheus.md) in full rather than assuming it duplicates the sibling manage/ batch's similarly-named manage/stats-monitoring-prometheus.md. This page is entirely about the DEPLOYMENT/INTEGRATION mechanics - the two shipped files (prometheus.yml, sync-gateway.rules.yml), where to copy them, and their content - with a 'Related _Statistics_ topics' link out to a separate manage/stats-monitoring.md page for the monitoring/analysis side. The two pages appear to be a deliberate split between 'how to wire Prometheus up' (this page) and 'what to do with the stats once wired' (the manage/ page), not a duplicate.
cross_product_finding: The shipped alerting rule set names real internal Sync Gateway metric identifiers directly in its expressions (sgw_security_auth_failed_count, sgw_cache_rev_cache_misses, sgw_delta_sync_delta_sync_miss, sgw_replication_sgr_num_docs_failed_to_pull/push, sgw_database_warn_xattr_size_count) - a rare case in the corpus of internal metric-name vocabulary appearing verbatim in a shipped, user-facing config artifact rather than only in a REST API reference table. None of these individual metric names is minted as its own concept here since the page presents them only as inline example content within one rules file, not as a documented reference list; flagged in case a metrics-reference page elsewhere in the corpus documents them formally.
